description: Eight step sequencer where each step can repeat, with a gate pattern per step, portamento and five play orders

params.text: Sets the voltage its step puts out, within the range picked in the menu
Sets how many times its step is held before the sequence moves on, 1 to 8
Picks which repeats of its step get a gate: none, only the first, every one, every other one, every third, every fourth, a random choice each time, or a gate held high right through for gliding
While on, its step slides from the previous voltage rather than jumping, at the speed set by the Glide knob
While off, its step is passed over and the sequence moves straight on
Sets how many of the eight steps the sequence runs through, 1 to 8
Sets how long a glide takes, 5ms to 2 seconds
Picks the order: forwards, backwards, pendulum, a random walk one step either way, or a random step each clock

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves the sequence on by one repeat
A rising edge sends the sequence back to the first step and blocks the clock for 1ms
Sets its step's voltage from the voltage patched here, overriding both the knob and the poly CV input
Sets the seed the random generator takes on a reset, so the same random order comes back; the seed is the voltage divided by ten
Sets all eight step voltages, one channel per step, where the step has no cable in its own CV input

outputs.text: The voltage of the step the sequence has reached, sliding into it when that step has Glide on
Passes the clock through while the current repeat has a gate, and stays high on a step whose gate pattern is the held one

notes: the number in the middle of the panel counts the repeats in one pass of the sequence, so it says how long the sequence has become
menu: Range — sets the span of the CV knobs; the choices run -3V to 3V, -2V to 2V, -1V to 1V, 0V to 1V and 0V to 2V, and it starts at -2V to 2V
Quantize — rounds every step voltage to the nearest semitone
Randomize CV — gives the eight CV knobs new random voltages inside the range set by the Range item
Randomize Gate Mode — gives each of the eight steps a randomly chosen gate mode
Randomize Repititions — gives each of the eight steps a randomly chosen repeat count; the menu spells it Repititions

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
